title: Object isomorphism for relatively flat tensor base change
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-pc-morphism-conventions], $g:T\to S$, and $E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $G^\bullet$ be a bounded-above complex of quasi-coherent modules termwise flat over $S$. Write $f_T:X_T\to T$ and $g\prime:X_T\to X$ for the projections [def-pc-base-change]. There is an isomorphism $Lg^*Rf_*(E\otimes^L G^\bullet)\cong Rf_{T,*}(L(g\prime)^*E\otimes^L (g\prime)^*G^\bullet)$, where the second factor is ordinary termwise tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], regarded in the derived category. The derived functors are [def-pc-derived-pullback] and [def-pc-derived-direct-image].

proof.text: Choose a K-flat resolution P of a complex representing E. Localizing its quasi-isomorphism gives eP:Q(P) ≅ E. Apply the existing public theorem kFlat_derivedTensor_comparison_natIso to constant one-object families and evaluate its components directly, without declaring a duplicate object-model lemma, to get Q(P) tensor Q(G) ≅ Q(Tot(P tensor G)). Compose with tensorIso eP.symm (Iso.refl _) to obtain α.

Apply relativelyFlat_derivedBaseChange_complex to f, g, E, G, the given quasi-coherence, upper bound and relative flatness, and P, hP, eP, α. Its IsIso proof supplies the base-change object isomorphism via asIso.

Extract the termwise total-tensor comparison φ from derivedPullback_tensorProduct. The recorded object and map formulas identify its functor F strictly with Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g′ by Functor.ext. Use φ at P and G; its statement provides this comparison for arbitrary complexes, so G is not required to be K-flat.

The explicit ringed-space pullback of P is definitionally its termwise scheme tensor pullback. Specialize isKFlat_pullback to the scheme structure map to prove this pulled P K-flat. Apply the same existing public natural derived-tensor comparison again and evaluate its components directly, now at g′*P and g′*G.

Extract the K-flat counit clause for the recorded derivedPullback g′ from exists_derivedPullback. Its object and map formulas again identify the underived functor with tensorPullback g′. The invertible counit at P gives dP:Lg′*Q(P) ≅ Q(g′*P). Compose Q(φ), the inverse pulled tensor comparison, and tensorIso (dP.symm followed by Lg′*(eP)) (Iso.refl _) to identify the ordinary pulled total tensor with Lg′*E tensor Q(g′*G). Map this identification through RfT,* and compose with the preceding base-change isomorphism.

theorem relativelyFlat_tensor_baseChange_iso
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (g : T ⟶ S) (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (hE : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X E) (G : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ)
    (hGb : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, b < n → IsZero (G.X n))
    (hGqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (G.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hGflat : ∀ n : ℤ, (G.X n).IsFlatOver f) :
    Nonempty ((derivedPullback g).obj
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (E ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj G)) ≅
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj
        ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj E ⊗
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).obj G)))
